decisions.reason: The agent requests an order ID but does not ask which order or item the request concerns.
The agent does not ask about condition or whether the item was used.
The agent does not explain a proposed action, exact amount, and payment method or request confirmation.
The agent does not ask when the item arrived or when the problem was reported.
The agent acknowledges the defect but does not ask what is wrong or whether the item differs from the order.
The agent does not ask for a photo or other evidence.
The agent explicitly requests the user ID and registered email or phone number to verify the account.
